mapper.select: SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_admin WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_user WHERE S_USER_ID = #{userId}) ) AS totalCount
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT PHONE FROM unipet.users UNION ALL SELECT PHONE FROM unipet.admin UNION ALL SELECT PHONE FROM unipet.store_user ) AS all_phones WHERE PHONE = #{phone}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unipet.users ( USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, NICKNAME, PHONE, EMAIL, USER_ADDR, FULL_ADDR, ZIPCODE, ROLE, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pwd}, #{userName}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{userAddr}, #{fullAddr}, #{zipcode}, 'USER', NOW() )
INSERT INTO unipet.store_user ( S_USER_ID, S_USER_PWD, CEO_NAME, BIZ_FILE_NAME, U_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pwd}, #{userName}, #{bizFileName}, 'PND' )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PWD AS pwd, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE, EMAIL, USER_ADDR AS userAddr, FULL_ADDR AS fullAddr, ZIPCODE, ROLE, USER_STATUS AS userStatus FROM unipet.users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT SU.S_USER_ID AS userId, SU.S_USER_PWD AS pwd, SU.CEO_NAME AS userName, SU.U_STATUS AS status, S.S_STATUS AS storeStatus, 'BIZ' AS role FROM unipet.store_user SU LEFT JOIN unipet.store S ON SU.S_USER_ID = S.S_USER_ID WHERE SU.S_USER_ID = #{userId} AND SU.U_STATUS NOT IN ('BAN', 'EXT')
SELECT S_USER_ID AS userId, CEO_NAME AS userName FROM unipet.store_user WHERE CEO_NAME = #{userName} AND S_USER_PWD = #{pwd} AND U_STATUS NOT IN ('BAN', 'EXT')
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName FROM unipet.users WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND PHONE = #{phone} LIMIT 1
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, PHONE FROM unipet.users WHERE TRIM(USER_ID) = TRIM(#{userId})
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickname, PHONE AS phone, EMAIL AS email, SOCIALTYPE AS socialType, ROLE AS role FROM unipet.users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unipet.users ( USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, NICKNAME, EMAIL, SOCIALTYPE, ROLE, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{socialType}, 'USER', NOW() )
INSERT INTO unipet.phone_verify ( PHONE, CODE, EXPIRE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{phone}, #{code}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MINUTE) )
mapper.select: SELECT VERIFY_NO AS verifyNo, PHONE AS phone, CODE AS code, EXPIRE_TIME AS expireTime, VERIFIED_YN AS verifiedYn FROM unipet.phone_verify WHERE PHONE = #{phone} ORDER BY VERIFY_NO DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT STORE_NO FROM unipet.store WHERE S_USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY STORE_NO DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unipet.store ( S_USER_ID, STORE_NAME, S_CATEGORY, S_ADDR, S_FULL_ADDR, LAT, LNG, S_STATUS, IS_OPEN ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{storeName}, #{sCategory}, #{sAddr}, #{sFullAddr}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{sStatus}, 'Y' )

INSERT INTO unipet.store_file ( STORE_NO, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_EXT, FILE_SIZE, IS_MAIN, IS_PROOF ) VALUES ( #{storeNo}, #{fileName}, #{originName}, #{filePath}, #{fileExt}, #{fileSize}, 'N', #{isProof} )
